answer: Each identity tends one ember: a locked stake that must be fed by one fresh verified job every epoch, or it goes out and its standing restarts from zero. A claim counts only if it passes an echo check: any peer replays the claim's receipt against the public record and must hear the same result back. Which claims face an echo check is set by a zephyr seed, the prior epoch's public hash published beforehand, so no farm can predict or steer the draw. The bill scales per head: one ember, one job, one echo check, and a farm cannot pay it once and copy it across clones.
